process.heading: Buy / Sell New or Used Two Wheelers
process.subtitle: Under New and Used Vehicles: search by need/budget, contact seller, verify yourself.

0.title: Find a vehicle
0.text: Search for a motorcycle or scooter according to your needs and budget on the company platform.

1.title: View information
1.text: Review model, year, condition, estimated price, photos, location and registration related details where available.

2.title: Contact the seller
2.text: Contact the seller or a company representative regarding the vehicle you are interested in.

3.title: Inspect & complete
3.text: Personally inspect vehicle and papers, agree price, then complete purchase according to legal requirements.

buySell.buyerText: Find → view info → contact → inspect engine, body, documents & registration → finalize price → complete legal purchase.
buySell.sellerText: Owners list through the company system. Company verifies information according to its procedure.

scope.heading: Motorcycles and Scooters
scope.motorcycleText: Search various types of new and used motorcycles and contact owners or representatives directly.
scope.scooterText: A similar service for people looking to buy or sell scooters new or used.
scope.goalText: Connect buyers and sellers on an organized platform to make the transaction process simpler and clearer.

disclaimer.title: Important Clarification
disclaimer.text: Buyers are responsible for personally verifying the vehicle’s condition, ownership, registration and documents before purchasing. Information on the platform is not final legal proof of ownership. All transactions follow relevant laws and company terms. This program is a marketplace it does not include a Car Plan style installment saving plan for motorcycles.
